About color & filters

PNG/JPEG channels are rendered colors, not calibrated science passbands. Ridges can trace arms, bars, rings, stars or noise. These display filters do not classify a structure.

Projection geometry

0° inclination is face-on. Disk angle is counterclockwise from image right, not a sky position angle. Supply a disk geometry before interpreting pitch or radial gaps.

MEASUREMENT NOTES Display images, manual geometry & calibration

The canvas measures the original image grid, including when a preview is resampled. Trace a single continuous arm for a descriptive logarithmic pitch fit; use a consistent disk center, inclination and major axis. Radial gaps require crossings along the same radial direction. Manual marks are not independently validated arm detections.

The native FITS tools in the source repository handle calibrated multiband images separately. Browser RGB filters do not reproduce those science measurements.

BOUNDARY CONDITIONS

Finite edge—

RADIAL PROFILE COMPUTED EQUILIBRIUM

Density and pressure vanish at the finite edge. Outside it, the gravitational field has a Keplerian circular-speed tail.

MODEL & EQUATIONS Lowered-isothermal, pressure-supported equilibrium

The solver integrates dW/dx = −m/x² and dm/dx = x²ρ/ρ₀. Density and pressure follow the lowered distribution’s velocity moments and vanish at the finite boundary. The scale s differs from the radius-dependent local velocity dispersion.

This is a known spherical baseline without a baryonic disk. Its parameters are not fitted to your image. Agreement with a rotation curve would not establish viscosity or dark-matter microphysics.

INCREMENTAL REDSHIFT INFORMATION

Does arm structure improve the estimate?

Across 59 fresh strong-spiral galaxies, the mean absolute catalog-redshift error was 0.01277 with photometry, size and basic image features, and 0.01253 after adding arm scores.

Equal sky-group improvement+0.0004495% interval [−0.00055, +0.00144]

The interval includes zero. This cohort does not establish an incremental distance benefit. Catalog redshift prediction differs from an independent geometric distance.

COHORT & LIMITS Same-survey validation, missing inputs & spatial labels

This is a selected same-survey population test, not validation on another survey. One of 99 images failed input guards; its unchanged catalog predictions remain in the redshift evaluation. AP is undefined when spatial annotations are absent or have only one class.

These results evaluate arm regions, not automatically recovered centerlines, pitch, physical widths or viscosity.
